notes.title: Gaming Copilot v1.2.0 Update: Real-time Translation Break Language Barriers
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your continued support and companionship! To make your gaming experience more seamless and immersive, Gaming Copilot has released the brand-new v1.2.0 update. This update brings several practical optimizations to make every adventure even more enjoyable!

1. New Translation Feature: Unlock Global Gaming Without Language Barriers
Now, you can summon Gaming Copilot to translate in-game text in real-time while playing! Whether it’s quest dialogues, item descriptions, or hidden lore, simply press a hotkey to translate text into 12 common languages (such as English, Japanese, and Korean). The translation interface supports adjustable transparency and font size, and you can switch between translation and chat modes with a single click.

Many players abandon their favorite games due to language barriers, and this feature aims to break that limitation. While the current translation accuracy is still being optimized (testing phase), it already helps you quickly understand game content without missing key details. We will continue improving it in future updates to make cross-server co-op even easier!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/f88098466425956781431f6a688ec79223977288.png

2. Character Art Customization: A More Flexible Companion Experience
You can now freely adjust the transparency and position of your companion character! Depending on the game scene, you can set character transparency independently (to avoid screen obstruction) or drag the character anywhere on the screen.

Whether you need full focus during intense battles or prefer a quiet companion while exploring, this feature ensures that your AI buddy is "just right"—never intrusive, yet always by your side for added immersion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/092fbaef1ec3e0020e3b4426b8b131f44a604ff0.png

3. Smarter AI Conversations: More Human-like, Better at Solving Problems
Gaming Copilot’s conversation logic and response speed have been greatly improved! Now, it can not only chat more naturally but also integrate search results directly into its answers (e.g., how to obtain rare items or unlock special achievements), allowing for quick solutions even to niche problems. The "Deep Thinking Mode" remains available for those who want to explore complex strategies.

Whether you’re a beginner asking, "How can I level up fast?" or a veteran wondering, "What’s the best way to defeat the hidden boss?" the optimized AI provides more precise and human-like assistance, truly becoming your "gaming encyclopedia."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/d63af1569f5badcf966f18c74819e27d45db9639.png

4. Expanded Guide Library & Stability Enhancements
This update includes expert guides for several popular games (with more to come), covering story analysis, map routes, gear combinations, and other useful content.

Additionally, we’ve fixed multiple bugs reported in previous versions, improved system stability, and enhanced response speed to ensure a smoother interaction with Gaming Copilot!

We firmly believe that the magic of gaming lies in exploration and connection. Gaming Copilot is here to make every adventure more free, warm, and full of possibilities. If you have any suggestions or feedback on the new features, feel free to let us know—your voice drives our progress!

See you in the game, fellow adventurers!

notes.title: Gaming Copilot Update: Demo Release and Community Events!
notes.notes:
🚀 Gaming Copilot Demo is Now Live! 🎮🤖
Hey, gamers! We're super excited to announce that the Gaming Copilot Demo is ready and can help you conquer the gaming world! 🕹️ Let our AI game assistant become your trusted ally. Here are a few things you need to know:

Fullscreen mode mischief!
💡Some games might experience display issues in fullscreen mode, such as flickering, disappearing windows, or accidentally switching back to the desktop. Don't worry! Try switching to windowed or borderless mode, and your gaming experience will be back on track.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/371afa2d82b3234c75f761b1014a719fe5354298.png

AI might make some mistakes...but it's getting smarter!
💡 Our team is constantly optimizing game strategies and the AI model. If the AI gives you an answer that seems a bit ""off,"" just tell it: ""Try again!"" It'll rethink and give you a more reliable response. After all, AI learns too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/35de3569e05653c69f8b2d3a632eea1a495288b9.png

Your feedback helps us improve! 
💡We are constantly improving based on your feedback! We haven’t been able to test all games yet, If you encounter any issues, feel free to reach out to us through Discord, Twitter, YouTube, or even Email, and we’ll address them as soon as possible. Your feedback is what drives our evolution!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/ded962e9f611a27c156883eb1c806bb4ff6f90e8.png

Community Update!

🌟Quiz Challenges: Regular quiz events to test your gaming knowledge, climb the leaderboard, and win big prizes!


🌟Giveaway: Participate in community interactions and stand a chance to enter lucky draws for game items and gift cards!


🌟Invite Rewards: Invite friends to the community, and once your invites reach certain milestones, you'll earn exclusive rewards. The bigger the community, the bigger the rewards!


🌟Creative Memes Contest: Share your funniest and most creative game memes, win votes from the community, and earn rewards and titles!

We've already given away over $300 in gift cards and game rewards, and more community events are underway. Come join us and enjoy the fun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/5de9bf289ec1c89d9381b8a20c3e0a5566441b14.png

Development Progress

Added Window Pinning: Keep the window on top, no more losing it behind other apps!


Support for Full Window Hiding: Don’t want the window to distract you? Now you can completely hide it!


Added AI Reply Sound Notification: AI has replied! You’ll get a sound notification, so you won’t miss it even when gaming!


Added Stop AI Reply Feature: In a hurry? You can now interrupt the AI’s response and ask again!


Fixed Repeated Running Reminders: Annoying repeated reminders are gone, everything is cleaner!


Added Support for Strategy Games: Strategy game fans, rejoice! We’ve added more support just for you!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/ad795b30802cdd664ca4187e3c30e85d462829f1.png

Your game, your choice!
Got a game you want AI to support? Let us know! 🎮 We'll prioritize the games the community loves the most, making Gaming Copilot your trusted gaming companion.
